## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Either a background task invokes the classifier and an integration test...

The system SHALL ensure that either a background task invokes the classifier and an integration test shows an audit event producing a classification, or the module and its docs references are deleted and the test suite passes.

#### Scenario: Either a background task invokes the classifier and an integration test...

WHEN `wire-or-remove-audit-triage-classifier` is implemented
THEN Either a background task invokes the classifier and an integration test shows an audit event producing a classification, or the module and its docs references are deleted and the test suite passes.

### Requirement: The decision is recorded in docs/decisions/ or the coordinator README with...

The system SHALL ensure that the decision is recorded in docs/decisions/ or the coordinator README with the reason.

#### Scenario: The decision is recorded in docs/decisions/ or the coordinator README with...

WHEN `wire-or-remove-audit-triage-classifier` is implemented
THEN The decision is recorded in docs/decisions/ or the coordinator README with the reason.

### Requirement: GitHub issue #496 is closed by the merged change

The system SHALL ensure that gitHub issue #496 is closed by the merged change.

#### Scenario: GitHub issue #496 is closed by the merged change

WHEN `wire-or-remove-audit-triage-classifier` is implemented
THEN GitHub issue #496 is closed by the merged change.
